_about: The route-feel gate's stated reasons (node tools/flow-audit.js gate; docs/ROUTE-FEEL.md). Each row accepts one check the candidate's flow audit fails against the shipped guides: `check` (score, backtracks_avoidable, passed_givers_near, passed_enders for a guide; back_and_forth, wasted_min, carried_far, carried_hours, never_handed, log_cap for a branch), the `guide` or `branch` it names ("*" for all), and the `mode` and `faction` it holds in (left out or "*": all; "run*": every mode with dungeons on Run). `reason` says why the route is better that way for players, on our own evidence: levels, time carried, a dangerous spot, a fixed report. Rows sorted by faction, guide or branch, check.

reasons.reason: Two walks back inside the Riverglades guide: Hurley offers Helping Hands only once Curly is found by the river (If a Tree Falls), and his escort walks back to her, about 500 yards; Sunnyglade's givers stand on the town's north side and its work starts at the ritual circles in the middle, about 360 yards back, a minute.

Each zone's own walks back: the Riverglades' two (Hurley's escort back to Curly; Sunnyglade's givers before its ritual circles) and Mount Hyjal's, which its own mode keeps as shipped; the gate compares this with the route that takes none of the three zones.
On the Mount Hyjal route the six quests of the last trip are now handed in after the zone instead of never; carrying them through Hyjal is the price.

Taking all three zones keeps the route's quests in the log longer, about 120 quest-hours more in all (flow model): the quests carried from the 50-60 guides ride through Mount Hyjal, and the 40-50 ones through the Riverglades and Shen'dralas. Each zone alone passes its own mode.

Maerion's Misery (97009): its Felhound Spikes drop from about one Defiling Hound in ten (one spike from eleven kills in the recording), so Mount Hyjal hands it in only as optional work; its Hyjal mode carries the same quest.

The Riverglades walk more than Desolace's south loop they replace: the ride in through Blackrock Pass, three hubs (Farholde Keep, Terral's Watch, Powderfuse Port) and the way out by Stormwind and Menethil Harbor; with 92 quests the route still reaches 60 about 4.5 hours sooner (flow model).

The three zones' own travel (Blackrock Pass and the Riverglades' hubs, the detour through Desolace into Shen'dralas, Everlook and the Tainted Foothills for Mount Hyjal), measured against the route that takes none of them.

Shen'dralas is a detour from the Badlands & Hinterlands guide through Desolace and back to Feralas: about a quarter of an hour more walking for its 11 quests, and about half an hour sooner to 60 (flow model).
Blackrock Blockade, Blackrock Menace and Alther's Mill are taken on Redridge's second visit, which works them, instead of riding the log for 7-8 hours from the first Lakeshire stop.
The passed givers are Blackrock Blockade, Blackrock Menace and Alther's Mill, taken on Redridge's second visit, which works them, instead of carried 7-8 hours.
Retrieval for Mauren is taken on the Mage Quarter stop right before the Mirage Raceway, where its basilisks are; taken at 25 it rode the log for more than 8 hours.
The passed giver is Retrieval for Mauren, taken on the Mage Quarter stop right before its work instead of carried more than 8 hours.

The passed giver is Crate Expectations (92009, Nami in Everlook), Mount Hyjal's quest, taken on Mount Hyjal's own Everlook stop.

Silithus to 60 folds the Eastern Kingdoms trip at 58 into the last guide: one ocean crossing pair and one guide fewer, and its class training on stops the route makes anyway, for more turns inside the guide; about a minute sooner to 60 on average.

Mount Hyjal leaves A Clever Creature (Jereman) and Trail Assist (Galvinquam) until the guide's way back through the Cradle before Dae'gun and the Summit, and takes Anywhere But Here after Mourning's Rest: the quest log stays at the game's 40 (it held 42 at the Shrine of Aviana).

Ambermill Investigations (479) is taken on the Sepulcher stop of the ride to Hillsbrad at 22 and handed to Allister on the Hillsbrad guide's flight back to the Sepulcher, about 90 minutes, like Beren's Peril and Watching the Roads beside it, instead of at 14-15 among Ambermill's Mages, Serpents and level 17-18 Conjurors (5 of 14 recorded players died there); Dangerous! (567) is no longer carried from Hillsbrad at 24 to the visit at 30 (about 8 hours).

Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i (3122) is taken at the end of Feralas & Tanaris and handed in at Camp Mojache in the next Feralas guide; with Shen'dralas offered between the two (at 45, where its quests fit, instead of after the next guide at 47), it rides through the Shen'dralas guide: one quest, for about 45 minutes.

Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle (level 27, at the top of the Venture Co. tower) is taken from Ziz Fizziks on the way back down from Sun Rock, about a level later than on the way up, for a walk out to the tower and back of about 1.3 km; Battle of Hillsbrad's smithy (Blacksmith Verringtan 26 with his apprentices) waits for the Tarren Mill visit at about 30. Both keep players off mobs two levels above them.
The Warrior class-quest walk to Orgrimmar crosses the Razormane camps before the Barrens guide's Crossroads quests; one return there saves a separate class trip.

Mebok's Raptor Horns (Sunscale Scytheclaws 16-18) and the WANTED poster's Baron Longshore (16) are passed on the first Ratchet stop at 15-16 and taken on the second at 18; Captain Thalo'thas's The Guns of Northwatch (Captain Fairmount 20 and two cannoneers 19, each with a healer and guards, 8 recorded deaths at 18-19) on the Ratchet stop after level 20 training; Gilthares is passed while the hold is cleared, as #907 asks.

The passed givers are Raptor Horns and Baron Longshore (taken on the second Ratchet stop at 18) and The Guns of Northwatch (taken after level 20 training), each kept off mobs two levels above the player.

Allister's Ambermill Investigations (479) is left on the Sepulcher stop at 14 and taken on the ride through Silverpine at 22: Ambermill's Mages fight beside Dalaran Serpents with Conjurors (17-18) among them, and 5 of 14 recorded players died there.
The passed giver is Ambermill Investigations, taken on the ride through Silverpine at 22 instead of at 14 among level 15-18 casters.

The passed giver is Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, taken from Ziz on the way down from Sun Rock instead of on the way up, two levels under Gerenzo.

The Thunder Bluff stop also takes Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem (3762) from Innkeeper Pala, a walk into the inn and back out; the Stranglethorn start flies Stonard to Booty Bay and passes Nimboya at Grom'gol on the way to the zeppelin: one flight and one Grom'gol stop fewer.

Winterfall Activity (8464) is handed to Salfa three levels earlier, where the Eastern Plaguelands guide rides out of Timbermaw's tunnel, so this guide has one quest fewer; its Toxic Horrors are worked at the north tip of Irontree Woods, away from the level 59 elite walkers and Vartrus (#1575).

Meal Appeal (97246) is taken on the Orgrimmar stop the next guide makes anyway, with the flight path and the bind; the Warrior and Shaman class quests walk through the Razormane country before the Crossroads quests, which every race takes in the Barrens guide, and save those classes a separate class trip.
The passed givers are Meal Appeal (97246), taken on the next guide's Orgrimmar stop, and the Crossroads quests the Warrior and Shaman class-quest walk passes before the Barrens guide takes them.

Stormy Potential (97282) follows A Simmering Storm (97281) from the Dull Storm Orb, a chance drop: the orb quest's hand-in to Rezlak and Stormy Potential's accept are on a step shown only while A Simmering Storm is carried, and Stormy Potential's hand-in waits for the quest in the log. Before, that hand-in did not wait for it (its accept was optional), so a walk that takes no optional quest counted one quest more; the score is per 10 quests.
